lines.head: Only two Product Managers
lines.sub: Principals covered by more PMs couldn't record them all.
lines.text: A principal could only list two Product Managers, even when more people managed it.
lines.say: A principal could only list two Product Managers, even when more people managed it.

lines.head: Add as many as you need
lines.sub: Mark one as primary. Untick Active at hand-over.
lines.text: Now, any number of Product Managers can be added. One is marked as primary, and Active can be unticked when someone hands over.
lines.say: Now, any number of Product Managers can be added. One is marked as primary, and Active can be unticked when someone hands over.

lines.head: A third PM, set as primary
lines.sub: The primary PM also shows as the Product Owner.
lines.text: Here, a third Product Manager is added and set as primary. They also show as the account's Product Owner.
lines.say: Here, a third Product Manager is added and set as primary. They also show as the account's Product Owner.

lines.head: Access follows the list
lines.sub: Listed PMs see their principal's leads and opportunities.
lines.text: Everyone on the list automatically sees the principal's leads and opportunities.
lines.say: Everyone on the list automatically sees the principal's leads and opportunities.
